families.purpose: Establish identity, organization context, permissions, environment, and foundational platform access.
families.terminal_outcome: An authenticated and authorized user, agent, application, or integration can safely access only permitted SHS BOS capabilities and data.

families.purpose: Bring external and internal claims, events, files, and records into SHS BOS without treating them as certified truth.
families.terminal_outcome: A traceable, permissioned, normalized source claim enters the SHS BOS processing pipeline with source and connection provenance.

families.purpose: Create canonical entities, relationships, normalized events, mappings, and provenance.
families.terminal_outcome: Source claims are associated with consistent canonical entities and events while retaining traceable provenance and unresolved identity warnings.

families.purpose: Evaluate evidence, resolve conflicts, and create certified, confidence-scored, readiness-aware truth packages.
families.terminal_outcome: The system produces one traceable truth package stating what is known, confidence, remaining conflicts, and permitted uses.

families.purpose: Explain, summarize, simulate, recommend, and translate certified truth while controlling AI behavior.
families.terminal_outcome: A permissioned user or system receives an audience-appropriate, Oracle-grounded explanation or recommendation with a trust envelope and audit record.

families.purpose: Move work between users, teams, systems, and approval stages.
families.terminal_outcome: A governed task or decision moves from initiation through assignment, approval, action, acknowledgement, and audit completion.

families.purpose: Run SHS client acquisition, production, delivery, maintenance, and lifecycle operations.
families.terminal_outcome: A client moves from qualified opportunity through approved build, QA, release, ClientOps, reporting, maintenance, renewal, and measurable ROI.

families.purpose: Convert certified truth and approved operational data into role-appropriate reports, exports, briefs, and institutional records.
families.terminal_outcome: An authorized audience receives an accurate, traceable, appropriately disclosed report or decision output based on certified or approved truth.

families.purpose: Track operational events, usage, system condition, workflow movement, risks, failures, revenue signals, and impact signals.
families.terminal_outcome: Leadership and operators can see what happened, what changed, what is blocked, what failed, and what requires action.

families.purpose: Protect architecture, system behavior, data, releases, and institutional accountability.
families.terminal_outcome: Architecture and releases move forward only when ownership, security, testing, documentation, and anti-drift requirements are satisfied.

families.purpose: Turn SHS BOS into a deployable and governable commercial platform.
families.terminal_outcome: A client has a clearly defined product package, authorized capabilities, support level, commercial terms, renewal state, and measurable service value.

families.purpose: Connect SHF program activities, evidence, outcomes, and approved impact into SHS BOS infrastructure without confusing organizational ownership.
families.terminal_outcome: SHF program activity becomes secure, verified, traceable, reportable impact while SHF retains mission/program ownership and SHS retains infrastructure ownership.
